about: Fixtures a cross lane's emulator fails for a reason of its own, which the test program reports as expected host failures on that runner rather than counting. Each row names the fixture, the runners it fails under, every failure line it may fail with, and why; a listed fixture that fails any other way, or passes, fails the run. A row with needs_binfmt does not apply where a binfmt_misc handler for the runner is registered. See compiler/tests/README.md, Lanes.

failures: the program's own exit status (expected 42, actual 8)
expected.reason: QEMU 11.1 translates STLR as a release barrier and then the store, and LDAR as the load and then an acquire barrier, so nothing keeps a store-release before a later load-acquire, which ARMv8 orders (RCsc); on an x86-64 host the store buffer then lets both seq_cst loads of a store-buffering round read the old values, at --optimize speed in every local run. Native arm64 orders them
